description: Structure of a Statistics Canada table: its dimensions and their members with member IDs. Large dimensions are truncated — pass member_filter (e.g. 'gasoline') to find specific members. Use the member IDs with get_data_by_coordinate.

member_filter.description: Keyword to filter dimension members by name

product_id.description: Table product ID from search_tables, e.g. 18100004

title: Get table dimensions and members
